fusions.name: Cantering Blow
fusions.desc: A drumming kick that deals 4 damage and makes the target [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 3 seconds. For 2s after using it, you move 10% faster.

fusions.name: Stampede
fusions.desc: Stomps down, dealing 28 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles. When it hits, you and your allies deal 20% more damage for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: Barded Gallop
fusions.desc: Raises your armour by 20% for 10 seconds. Your movement speed rises 30% for 6s after you use it.

fusions.name: Gathering Pace
fusions.desc: Every few paces you cover, your physical damage rises by 25% for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
